page: Microsoft Azure D4ads_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at 4.5 GHz, featuring 4 vCPUs allocated across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core on an x86_64 architecture. Memory capacity is configured at 16.0 GB of RAM, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It includes an integrated 236 GB NVMe SSD for fast local scratch storage. GPU hardware is not bundled with this configuration.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-thread performance, ranking in the top tier (top 10%) for single-core stress-ng tests, single-threaded gzip compression at 40.86 GB/sec, and bzip3 decompression at 18.13 GB/sec. The processor supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16. Overall multi-core throughput sits in the middle 50%, with PassMark CPU scoring 10120.39 and stress-ng multi-core testing reaching 7572.38. Highly parallel decompression represents a performance tradeoff, ranking in the bottom 25% for multi-threaded bzip3.

Data handling benchmarks show average performance across workloads, including memory bandwidth testing at 48.84 GB/sec for uncached reads and 34.17 GB/sec for uncached writes. Database and caching workloads register solid throughput, achieving 8.21 million Redis SET operations per second and a PassMark database score of 2868.01. Inference tests for small 135M language models achieve 829.5 prompt tokens per second, but medium 7B model prompt processing drops into the bottom 10% at 16.53 tokens per second due to the 4-vCPU ceiling.

The qualitative cost efficiency of the D4ads_v7 is driven by its modern AMD EPYC core density combined with high single-core clocks and fast local NVMe storage. It delivers reliable value for general compute tasks, microservices, web serving with static throughput up to 9.02 GB/sec, intermediate database caching, and staging environments that benefit from bundled local high-speed disk space.
description: Microsoft Azure D4ads_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at 4.5 GHz. Configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores and 16.0 GB of RAM, it maintains a balanced 1:4 allocation alongside a 236 GB local NVMe SSD. It features no GPU hardware. In benchmark testing, the instance exhibits top-tier single-core performance, excelling in stress-ng single-thread tests and gzip compression, supported by AVX-512 instruction extensions. Multi-threaded execution, memory bandwidth, and caching operations fall in the middle 50% category, with Redis SET operations achieving 8.21 million per second. While multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and larger LLM prompt processing represent scaling limits, the instance delivers dependable efficiency for web serving, microservices, database caching, and build tasks requiring local high-speed temporary storage.
